newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan to award Aqaba refinery tender by end 1997.
newsitem.headline: Jordan to award Aqaba refinery tender by end 1997.

text.p: Jordan said on Thursday it hoped to award the project to build an export-oriented refinery in its Red Sea port of Aqaba to an international refiner by the year end.
Ministry of Energy Undersecretary Ahmad Bashir said Jordan had received a number of offers after it invited proposals to construct the refinery on a build, own and operate (BOO) basis.
The closing date for bids was April 30.
"We received a number of offers from U.S. and Asian firms and they are still under evaluation," Ahmad Bashir told Reuters.
Bashir, without elaborating, said the ministry hoped to award the deal by the end of the year.
Earlier this year Jordan said it hoped the 210,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery complex could be completed within four years.
The refinery will not affect the concession of Jordan's existing 100,000 bpd Zarqa refinery for domestic sales that relies solely on Iraqi crude.
